@Nils-ChristianIseke approved - can you do this for all controllers and planners?
@SteveMacenski do you want me to do this in this PR?

Yes please - so we resolve the scope of the ticket. I think there's one callout that should also be made: controller_frequency. This is sometimes used in the controllers and obtained by the main Controller Server which is dynamically reconfigurable. If this parameter is changed, then I think we should trigger the update as well. Its used in virtually all of the controllers (DWB, MPPI, RPP, Rotation Shim). it actually looks like RPP needs to have controller_frequency checked and updated in the dynamic parameter callback. Right now it doesn't update.


The other option would be to remove this as a dynamic parameter option so its cannot be updated. Which... seems reasonable.


I didn't see any shared Planner Server x Planner Plugin parameter overlap, but please check to make sure I didn't miss anything :-)

What about MPPI?
